rv.q: A promising start for Byrne then – and a triumphant one for Ali.
Breakfast Club update by Sabrina Ali is joyful and swaggering
Sharp lines and strong characterisation overwhelm a slightly stagnant story, but Ali keeps the audience laughing.
It is a perfect example of how the arts can and should be used to create social and political change.

cn.t: This sassy Muslim riff on The Breakfast Club delights with sharp dialogue and strong characterization, though the story occasionally stagnates. A pure pleasure that marks a promising debut at the Royal Court.
